summary: Carlyle Credit Solutions (a BDC) filed an 8-K to report a routine continuous private offering of Class I common stock and a regular dividend declaration. On July 27, 2026, it issued 2,904,955 shares for $52.3M aggregate consideration, exempt under Regulation D/S. The board declared a $0.14/share cash dividend payable Aug 27, 2026. Net asset value was $18.01/share as of June 30. This is an ordinary capital raise and dividend announcement for a BDC, not a special-situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or any other enumerated special situation. The filing is purely operational, reporting standard issuance and dividend activities.
